soundtrack.music: Warm, modern electronic instrumental for a premium mobile app advert. Around 100 BPM. Soft analog synth pads, a clean plucked melody, round bass and light, tight drums. Optimistic and confident, polished and uncluttered, leaving room for a voice-over on top. Ends on a resolved chord. No vocals.
